title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 1+1 + PARKING SPACE IN MANGALEM 21
description_en: In the Mangalem 21 complex, we offer for sale a 1+1 apartment located on the 7th floor facing east of a 9-story building. It is organized in a living room together with a cooking area, 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom and a balcony. The property is mortgaged and sold furnished. A parking post -1 can be offered for an extra price (it is optional). For more information, contact us.
